review: Claude Code compared each label with the top of its rendered workbook page (badge, lesson number and first activity heading) on 2 Nov 2026.
scope: Grade 1 Hindi workbook labels only. Repairs legacy-font decoding damage, restores dropped or garbled स्कूल रेडिनेस badge words, the missing पढ़ें heading on PDF p58, and the tick (✓) and anusvara signs that decoded as empty brackets. Badge order is normalised to badge → पाठ number → heading. Grades 2–3 labels were scanned and not changed.
